doc: One tile of grass to grow: a hex cell's worth of blades of a species in a season, one of its variants (or one of the plain ground plates after them), at the level of detail the runtime picked.

fields.name: variant
fields.doc: Which tile: below the genome's variants, a grass tile; after them, a plate for water, rock, sand, path, then bare soil; past those it wraps.

fields.name: detail
fields.doc: Level of detail, chosen by the runtime from size on screen: blades, fewer wider blades, tufts, then a mat.
